segments.ja154:1.1: Idhūragānaṃ pavaro paviṭṭho, selassa vaṇṇena pamokkhamicchaṃ;
segments.ja154:1.3: Brahmañca vaṇṇaṃ [vakkaṃ (ka.)] apacāyamāno, bubhukkhito no vitarāmi [visahāmi (ka. si. syā. pī.)] bhottuṃ.
segments.ja154:2.1: So brahmagutto cirameva jīva, dibyā ca te pātubhavantu bhakkhā;
segments.ja154:2.3: Yo brahmavaṇṇaṃ apacāyamāno, bubhukkhito no vitarāsi [sabbatthapi samānaṃ] bhottunti.
